title: OxygenOS on Redmi Note 5 Pro Old Port, Still Worth Flashing?
blurb: OxygenOS on the Redmi Note 5 Pro — the OnePlus look running on whyred, and an honest take on what still works today and what really doesn't.
video_description:
OxygenOS on the Redmi Note 5 Pro — the OnePlus look running on whyred, and an honest take on what still works today and what really doesn't.

The Redmi Note 5 Pro is ancient by now, and that's exactly why people keep flashing it. OxygenOS brings the clean OnePlus interface — its own launcher, its own gestures, that familiar settings layout — and seeing it boot on a whyred is genuinely fun. This is an official build for the device, meaning it's put together to run properly on this hardware rather than being a half-finished experiment. In the video I go through a normal day on the ROM: setup, the launcher, settings, the camera, and how it behaves when you're actually using it. Don't expect a benchmark show, because this phone is old and the numbers would just make everyone sad.

📱 Device  : Redmi Note 5 Pro (whyred)
🧩 ROM     : OxygenOS (Official build for whyred)

🔬 What Was Tested
• First boot and the setup wizard
• The OxygenOS launcher and system apps
• Gestures and navigation
• Settings, quick toggles and the notification shade
• Camera app opening and basic shots
• Battery drain across a normal day
• How the phone feels in daily scrolling

📊 Verdict
The interface is the reason to flash this. It's clean, it's different from MIUI, and on a device this old it feels lighter than you'd expect. What you won't get is modern Android underneath, so don't open it expecting new system features. The camera is the weakest part of almost any port on old hardware, and that pattern holds here. If you're flashing it to daily drive, do it for the look and keep your expectations realistic.

❓ Common Questions
Q: Do I need to unlock the bootloader? A: Yes, there's no way around that.
Q: Is it a daily driver? A: For light use, yes. For heavy gaming, no.
Q: Will banking apps work? A: Don't count on it with a ported ROM.
